title: Slanted And Enchanted
notes:
1st US pressing:  
- 611 Broadway address used in all three locations (back cover and both labels)
- Three lines of text below the Matador logo on back cover

Standard weight LP.

Recorded Jan 13-20 1991 Stockton CA, Louder Than You Think 16 Track
Track B2 "Here" recorded Dec 24, 1990 at South Makepeace Studios, Brooklyn, NY

Jacket made in Canada.

© Treble Kicker Esq.
© 1991 One Last Capillary/ Treble Kicker E.E.
© ℗ Matador Records Inc 1991 (label side one)
© ℗ 1992 Matador Records Inc.

Title on back cover and vinyl label reads, "S + E" '91.
Includes double-sided 11"x11'' insert (lyrics / credits, contains i.a. 'Misty: David B, Bob N, Mark I, K-Pipe, Mark O, 611 Posse Drag City (all exvolved').

Mastered By, Mastering and Pressing plants uncredited, identified by runout etchings.
